name: sitevitals
description: Passive security hygiene audit for websites and local code repos. Scores out of 100 with a plain-English fix per failure. Report-only: never modifies the target, never verifies found secrets live. Only package names + versions leave the machine (OSV lookup).

commands.name: url-audit
commands.description: Audit a website: HTTPS redirect, security headers, cookie flags, TLS, DNS (SPF/DMARC/CAA), security.txt.
commands.sideEffects: Writes a self-contained HTML report to reports/. All checks are passive reads.

commands.name: repo-scan
commands.description: Audit a local working tree: leaked secrets (redacted), vulnerable deps via OSV (npm/PyPI/Go), JS/TS injection patterns, Dockerfile, license audit, CI config.
commands.sideEffects: Writes a self-contained HTML report to reports/. Never modifies the scanned repo. Never verifies secrets live.

commands.name: sbom
commands.description: Emit a CycloneDX 1.5 inventory of the repo's npm/PyPI/Go manifests. No scoring.
commands.sideEffects: Prints to stdout, or writes the file given by --sbom-out.

exitCodes.0: Scan completed and score >= --min-score (default 70). SBOM mode: success.
exitCodes.2: Usage or runtime error; no score produced.
